after-completing-underground-pass.npc: Traveller, thank the stars you're still around! I thought your time had come.

after-completing-underground-pass.player: I've still a few years in me yet. So what are you still doing down here?

after-completing-underground-pass.text: If the player has not completed Song of the Elves:

steps.npc: Well with Iban and his lot gone, we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.

after-completing-underground-pass.text: If the player has completed Song of the Elves:

steps.npc: Well Iban and his lot are gone and Lord Iorwerth is no longer an issue. That means we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.

after-completing-underground-pass.player: Fair enough. Well you take care of yourselves.
